read_first: exact front record selected by stable front ID
the one causal scheduler host named by that front next_boundary
only host, actor, resource, opposition, evidence and source owners that are explicitly referenced and causally relevant
separate player or NPC knowledge authority only when information delivery or recognition is being resolved
world-event registry and relevant domain reducer only when a material autonomous action is actually instantiated
write_order: validate stable front identity, current status, elapsed time, exact boundary equivalence, causal evidence and information limits
if goal, current step, actors, resources or opposition are absent, preserve null or empty authority and resolve only a supported no-op, block or externally caused transition
instantiate material autonomous action through the relevant world/domain authority before changing a front to claim its consequence
write authoritative host, actor, resource, opposition or other domain consequences before changing the front summary
update front truth, conditional stakes, constraints, current step and status only from persisted causal sources
append one immutable chronology entry for an actual transition; never rewrite prior entries
write player or NPC knowledge only through its dedicated authority after lawful delivery; visibility classification alone never grants knowledge
update the front next_boundary and its one causal scheduler host atomically and without changing world time unless the time_process contract separately authorizes advancement
rebuild the owner index only after authoritative front persistence succeeds, then run validators and read back both front and boundary
invariants: Front IDs are stable semantic IDs; map key and record id are identical.
The registry owns executable front truth. Indexes, routes, tests, prior pressure containers, chat memory and model recall are not front authority.
Canon is trajectory, not a forced result. Conditional stakes are not future facts and no reducer may select an outcome without causal resolution.
Missing goal, current step, actors, resources, opposition, evidence or sources remain null or empty; missing detail never becomes convenient support for action.
Every active, active_hidden or latent_active front has exactly one active causal scheduler host and an exactly matching settled_through and due_at boundary.
No front carries a hidden second clock; its next_boundary mirrors the causal scheduler rather than competing with it.
World truth, visibility, player knowledge and each NPC's knowledge are separate. Repository visibility never creates character knowledge.
Hidden status may preserve an existing hidden classification but does not identify who knows the front.
Chronology is append-only, time-ordered and source-backed. Maintenance migration creates no fictional in-world event.
A front transition cannot directly mutate player intent, grant capability, transfer resources, create relationships or resolve a world event without the relevant domain authority and receipt.
Front settlement never advances state/meta revision or world time by itself.
